LESSON: ISLAMIC MANNERS OF DRESSING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1.2: Islamic Manners of Dressing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Islamic Manners of Dressing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How should a Muslim dress?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam
2. observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah
3. appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah

Teach
• Today’s focus: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah” using a school example.
• Model B for “observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam
• Model 2: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah
• Model 3: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam
2. Practise: observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah
3. Practise: appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Islamic Manners of Dressing.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How should a Muslim dress?
2. What is the importance of the Islamic code of dress?
3. What are some of the dressing trends that should be avoided by a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe appropriate Islamic code of dressing as per the teachings of Islam
• observe Islamic manners of dressing as an act of ibadah
• appreciate Islamic code of dressing as a means of earning rewards from Allah

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
